- [fact] scripts/runner-lib.mjs#findings_max: At most 20 findings are kept per output (FINDINGS_MAX=20), and the parser scans lines from the bottom up, taking the last FINDINGS line found
- [fact] scripts/runner-lib.mjs#findings_max: FINDINGS_MAX is 20, the hard cap on absorbed findings per output
